product_boundary: Extend Agentic Data Engineering OS with a business-first foundation compiler. Do not create a standalone Backbone clone, do not use Catalyst, and do not modify Snowflake certification/question-bank artifacts.

phase_a.name: business-foundation deterministic dry-run planner
invariants: AI mapping output is advisory only and has no execution authority
Only an exact reviewed ApprovedFoundationConfig may produce a GenerationPlan
Any material ontology or mapping edit invalidates prior approval
GenerationPlan is deterministic for identical canonical approved inputs and architecture policy
Missing business grain or unresolved source authority blocks affected metric generation
Ambiguous cross-system business keys are never guessed
Configuration is governed as code with version, digest, diff, review and approval
Model count is not a success metric; complexity budget and rationale are required
Test count is not a success metric; business-risk coverage and reconciliation are required
Deterministic generation never self-certifies business correctness
required_negative_tests: same approved config produces same generation-plan digest
canonical object-key ordering is digest stable
unresolved source authority blocks conflicting metric
conflicting revenue definitions cannot silently collapse
stale source metadata becomes review or unknown per freshness policy
high low-value test count without reconciliation coverage fails quality gate
complexity-budget overrun requires explicit rationale and approval
new source requires impact analysis before artifact mutation
acceptance_evidence: focused unit/contract tests green at exact head SHA
full existing repository regression green at same head SHA
machine-readable contract fixtures for positive and refusal paths
no Snowflake credentials required for Phase A

later_gates: dbt/Snowflake artifact generation from exact approved plan

wip_gate.reason: ADE has active draft work including local-first deployment and RE-239. This research branch must not become a third uncontrolled implementation lane until bounded BUILDING capacity is available or explicitly reprioritized.

non_claims: No private Backbone service or implementation inspection
No claim that 542 models were necessary
No claim that 799 tests were sufficient
